name: Maedra
home: Temple of the Old Gods, Bramblewood
found: Temple of the Old Gods, at Zimru's side.
and_yet: The temple's dead bow as she passes.
wants: Not yet known, even to her.
oddly_also: Wept for Ildun-Ayenar before she changed; the dead took it as a sign she was ready.
anecdotes: Knew Ildun-Ayenar better than anyone realized.
Came to every funeral and vigil in Tagmira without being seen to arrive.
tragedies: Chose undeath. Whether that is a tragedy depends on what she does with it.
campaign_notes: Slow burn. Her presence should be felt before she appears. She and Zimru are consorts. The most human face of the alliance, and possibly its most dangerous element.
